title: How to File a Cashless Claim at a Network Hospital
chunk_text:
How to File a Cashless Claim at a Network Hospital
To access Cashless Inpatient Admission without out-of-pocket payment:
Step 1 - Pre-Authorization:
Present your ApexCare digital member ID card at the hospital's TPA / insurance helpdesk at least 48 hours prior to planned admission (or within 24 hours in emergency situations).
Step 2 - Verification:
The hospital submits the cashless pre-authorization form along with initial physician estimates to ApexCare claims desk.
Step 3 - Instant Approval:
ApexCare reviews and approves eligible expenses within 60 minutes for network hospitals.
Step 4 - Discharge:
Upon discharge, ApexCare settles the approved bill directly with the hospital. The member only pays non-medical expenses (such as registration fees or personal luxury items).

title: 1.1 INITIAL WAITING PERIOD (30 DAYS):
chunk_text:
1.1 INITIAL Mandatory Waiting Period (30 DAYS):
There is a strict thirty (30) day initial Mandatory Waiting Period starting from the policy effective date. No claim arising out of any illness or medical condition contracted during this first 30 days will be payable under any tier (Bronze, Silver, or Gold).
EXCEPTION: Emergency hospitalization directly resulting from an unexpected accidental bodily injury sustained after the effective date is covered immediately with zero (0) days Mandatory Waiting Period.

title: 1.2 PRE-EXISTING CONDITION (PEC) WAITING PERIOD (24 MONTHS):
chunk_text:
1.2 Pre-Existing Condition (Pre-Existing Condition (PEC)) (Pre-Existing Condition (PEC)) Mandatory Waiting Period (24 MONTHS):
Any Pre-Existing Condition (Pre-Existing Condition (PEC)) (defined as any illness, ailment, injury, or medical condition for which the insured showed symptoms, was diagnosed, received medical advice, or underwent treatment within the forty-eight (48) months prior to the policy start date, including Type 1/Type 2 diabetes, chronic hypertension, cardiovascular disorders, asthma, and thyroid diseases) is subject to a twenty-four (24) month continuous coverage Mandatory Waiting Period.
Claims relating directly or indirectly to Pre-Existing Condition (Pre-Existing Condition (PEC)) become eligible only after twenty-four (24) months of uninterrupted premium payment.

title: 1.3 SPECIFIC ILLNESS WAITING PERIOD (12 MONTHS):
1.4 MATERNITY & NEWBORN RIDER (10 MONTHS):
chunk_text:
1.4 MATERNITY & NEWBORN RIDER (10 MONTHS):
Maternity benefits are available as an optional rider on Silver plans and included by default in Gold Tier plans. A ten (10) month Mandatory Waiting Period applies from the inception date of the rider.
- Normal delivery: Covered up to $5,000 per confinement.
- Caesarean section (C-Section): Covered up to $8,000 per confinement.
- Newborn coverage: Automatic coverage for the newborn from day one up to 90 days under the mother's sum insured.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: SECTION 2: GENERAL POLICY EXCLUSIONS (NON-PAYABLE EXPENSES)
chunk_text:
SECTION 2: GENERAL POLICY EXCLUSIONS (NON-PAYABLE EXPENSES)

ApexCare shall not be liable to make any payment under this policy in respect of any expenses incurred by any insured person in connection with:

title: 2.1 COSMETIC & AESTHETIC PROCEDURES:
chunk_text:
2.1 COSMETIC & AESTHETIC PROCEDURES:
Cosmetic, aesthetic, or reconstructive surgery, laser tattoo removal, liposuction, hair transplants, rhinoplasty for non-trauma reasons, and treatments aimed purely at improving appearance or vanity.
Exception: Reconstructive surgery following accidental trauma, burns, or cancer resection (e.g. post-mastectomy breast reconstruction) is covered under Gold and Silver tiers upon prior authorization.

title: 2.2 INVESTIGATIONAL & EXPERIMENTAL TREATMENTS:
chunk_text:
2.2 INVESTIGATIONAL & EXPERIMENTAL TREATMENTS:
Any medical technology, drug, stem cell therapy, or procedure that is not scientifically validated or approved by the FDA / appropriate health authority as standard clinical care.

title: 2.3 HAZARDOUS SPORTS & INTENTIONAL ACTS:
chunk_text:
2.3 HAZARDOUS SPORTS & INTENTIONAL ACTS:
Injuries sustained while engaging as a professional in hazardous or extreme activities (such as skydiving, motor racing, scuba diving beyond 30 meters) unless an Adventure Sports Rider has been endorsed.
Self-inflicted injuries, suicide attempts, or medical consequences arising from the active commission of a felony or unlawful act.

title: 2.4 UNLICENSED HOSPITALS & NON-ALLOPATHIC CARE:
chunk_text:
2.4 UNLICENSED HOSPITALS & NON-ALLOPATHIC CARE:
Treatment received at facilities not officially recognized as licensed medical hospitals or clinics, or care provided by non-registered medical practitioners.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: 3.1 ROOM CATEGORY CAPS:
chunk_text:
3.1 ROOM CATEGORY CAPS:
- Bronze Tier: Standard shared twin-sharing room up to 1% of Sum Insured per day. ICU capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day.
- Silver Tier: Single private air-conditioned room up to $350 per day. ICU up to $700 per day.
- Gold Tier: No capping on room rent. Private suite / Deluxe room covered in full at all contracted network hospital facilities.

title: 3.2 NETWORK HOSPITAL CASHLESS ADMISSIONS:
chunk_text:
3.2 NETWORK HOSPITAL CASHLESS ADMISSIONS:
Cashless authorization is valid solely at ApexCare Empaneled Network Hospitals. If treated at a non-network facility, reimbursement claim forms must be submitted within thirty (30) calendar days of discharge with original itemized invoices, discharge summary, and pharmacy bills.

title: Underwriting Guideline: Eligible Age Range and Senior Retirement Qualification
chunk_text:
Rule: Eligible Age Range and Senior Retirement Qualification
Criteria: Primary applicant must be between 18 and 65 years of age at the time of policy inception. Dependent children are covered from 91 days to 25 years (if unmarried students). Senior or retired applicants aged 66 and above (including 67-year-old, 68-year-old, or 70+ retired applicants) cannot qualify for standard Bronze, Silver, or Gold products.
Action: Applicants aged 66 and above (e.g. 67-year-old retired applicant) are not eligible for standard plans. They must be routed to the Apex Senior Care specialized product or escalated to a human healthcare underwriter.

title: Underwriting Guideline: Tobacco and Smoking Status
chunk_text:
Rule: Tobacco and Smoking Status
Criteria: Applicants who have used cigarettes, cigars, chewing tobacco, or nicotine vapes within the past 12 months are classified as Tobacco Users.
Premium Impact: A mandatory 25% smoker loading is added to the base tier monthly premium.

title: Underwriting Guideline: Pre-Existing Conditions Acceptance Criteria
chunk_text:
Rule: Pre-Existing Condition (Pre-Existing Condition (PEC)) Acceptance Criteria
Criteria: Common chronic conditions (controlled Hypertension, controlled Type 2 Diabetes, mild Asthma, Hypothyroidism) are eligible for coverage subject to the mandatory 24-month Mandatory Waiting Period and a 10% risk loading.
Ineligible Conditions for Direct Online Issue: Active metastatic malignancy or chemotherapy within past 3 years, End-stage renal disease (ESRD) requiring dialysis, Congestive heart failure (Stage III/IV), Organ transplant recipient
Escalation Requirement: Must be marked INELIGIBLE for direct automated issuance; initiate immediate human underwriter escalation.

title: Underwriting Guideline: Body Mass Index (BMI) Thresholds
chunk_text:
Rule: Body Mass Index (BMI) Thresholds
Criteria: BMI 18.5 - 29.9 qualifies for standard rates. BMI 30.0 - 34.9 requires 15% loading. BMI 35.0+ requires medical record disclosure and tele-underwriting approval.

title: OBJECTION 1: "Why is your monthly premium higher than basic health plans?"
chunk_text:
OBJECTION 1: "Why is your monthly premium higher than basic health plans?"
Category: objection
Standard Grounded Response:
ApexCare's premium reflects comprehensive coverage with significantly lower out-of-pocket exposure when you actually need medical care. Unlike basic catastrophic plans that carry $8,000+ deductibles and restrictive networks:
1. ApexCare Gold features a low $750 deductible and 100% inpatient coverage up to $2,000,000 lifetime limit.
2. We provide $0 Co-payment preventive care, 24/7 unlimited telemedicine, and a network of over 4,200 hospitals with cashless admission.
3. In a single hospitalization event, members save thousands compared to high-deductible competitors.

title: OBJECTION 2: "I'm young and healthy, I don't need comprehensive insurance."
chunk_text:
OBJECTION 2: "I'm young and healthy, I don't need comprehensive insurance."
Category: objection
Standard Grounded Response:
Unexpected medical emergencies (such as appendicitis, sports injuries, or severe accidents) can cost $30,000 to $60,000 in acute hospitalization bills. Bronze tier starts at just $180/month, providing essential financial protection, immediate accident coverage with zero Mandatory Waiting Period, and 100% free annual preventive checkups.

title: OBJECTION 3: "Will you cover my pre-existing diabetes or high blood pressure?"
chunk_text:
OBJECTION 3: "Will you cover my pre-existing diabetes or high blood pressure?"
Category: objection
Standard Grounded Response:
Yes, ApexCare covers Pre-Existing Condition (Pre-Existing Condition (PEC)) such as controlled Type 2 diabetes and hypertension once the mandatory 24-month continuous coverage Mandatory Waiting Period is satisfied. Routine maintenance medications are also covered under our prescription formulary subject to standard plan copays.

title: FAQ 1: "What is the difference between In-Network and Out-of-Network care?"
chunk_text:
FAQ 1: "What is the difference between In-Network and Out-of-Network care?"
Category: faq
Standard Grounded Response:
In-network care at our 4,200+ partner hospitals is settled directly via cashless authorization, with primary care copays starting as low as $10 (Gold) or $25 (Silver). Out-of-network care requires upfront payment by the patient and submission of reimbursement claim forms within 30 days, subject to 30% higher co-insurance.

title: FAQ 2: "Can I add dental and vision coverage to my health plan?"
chunk_text:
FAQ 2: "Can I add dental and vision coverage to my health plan?"
Category: faq
Standard Grounded Response:
Yes. Both Silver and Gold tiers support optional Dental & Vision riders starting at $22/month, covering bi-annual dental cleanings, annual eye exams, and up to $200 allowance for prescription eyeglasses.
